cards.card_text: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and afterward as well, when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men.
cards.verse_text: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and afterward as well—when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men.
cards.snippet: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and afterward as well—when the sons…

cards.card_text: They even saw the Nephilim, and they say the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim.
cards.verse_text: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim!
cards.snippet: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim!
